offering_description.value: Operates Build-A-Bear stores where children and families make and customize plush bears and accessories, sold in person, online and through franchised stores. Revenue comes mainly from product sales, with party and in-store experience fees and franchise royalties.

primary_products.value: plush bears; clothing for bears; bear accessories; gift cards

primary_services.value: in-store make-your-own bear experience; birthday party events; bear care and repair

customer_segment.value: B2C: families, children and gift buyers

end_markets.value: toys and gifts; retail; family entertainment; events and parties

revenue_model.value: product sales: plush bears, clothing and accessories sold in stores and online; service fees: in-store bear-making experiences and birthday party packages; licensing or royalties: royalties and fees from franchised stores
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs its own bear characters and accessories, sold to families through its stores and website; retailer: runs company stores and an online shop, buying finished goods and selling to consumers; service provider: takes in customers for interactive bear-making sessions and parties, sold to families

geography_served.value: global: company stores in the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, plus franchised stores in other countries including the Middle East and Asia

specialization.value: niche specialist: customizable plush bears and their accessories and clothing

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated mall and shopping center stores; online: company website selling bears and accessories; partners / resellers: franchise partners operating Build-A-Bear stores abroad

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: children's product safety rules for toys, such as US CPSIA testing and labeling requirements
